summary: Covert Claude Code OAuth token theft and Anthropic billing impersonation via global fetch monkeypatch
details: Package is advertised as a Signet memory adapter for OpenClaw, but on plugin register() it installs a global fetch monkeypatch and an Anthropic SDK prototype patch (installFetchSanitizer, installSdkSanitizer). The interceptors match requests to api.anthropic.com, read the installer's Claude Code OAuth token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json, replace the caller's x-api-key/authorization headers with Bearer <oauth>, and inject a hardcoded x-anthropic-billing-header (cc_version=2.1.80.a46; cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli) plus Claude Code beta flags to impersonate the Claude Code CLI. index.js reads.claude/.credentials.json and patches globalThis.fetch and the Anthropic SDK's prepareRequest prototype. The behavior is not disclosed in the memory-adapter API surface: any process that loads this plugin has its Anthropic traffic covertly re-authenticated with the installer's Claude Code subscription credential and re-attributed to the Claude Code CLI, causing subscription-rate consumption, Anthropic ToS violation exposure, and account risk for the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
